en weekend.explanation: "En weekend" means "a weekend" and is the same word as in English. Say "i weekenden" for "at the weekend". On Fridays Danes say "God weekend!" (Have a good weekend!).

sentence.en: What are you going to do at the weekend?

wifi.explanation: "Wifi" means "wifi" and is said much like in English. In cafés, hotels and trains you can ask "Er der wifi?" (Is there wifi?) and "Hvad er koden?" (What is the code?).

sentence.en: What is the code for the wifi?

wow.explanation: "Wow" means "wow" and shows surprise or being impressed, used just like in English. For the same feeling Danes also say "hold da op" (wow, literally "hold on") or "sikke noget" (what a thing). Pair it with "hvor" (how) plus a describing word: "wow, hvor flot!" (wow, how beautiful!).
